"Minimum Food Quality

    Nations who suffer from intense levels of debt will be granted international aid by the World Assembly."

.

This alone can be exploited pretty badly in my opinion, since "intense debt" (or 1a in general) isn't really expanded upon. If a nation has debt that is times (x) more than their GDP, but they are still able to stay afloat (like the irl United States), it might just send needed international aid somewhere to a stable country who doesn't need it, but still qualifies for it.

2d and 2e are also pretty unnecessary, since it should be the responsibility of the nations' government to put in funding and research to their dieseases. I wouldn't be funding prevention or research of the fungal diesease "ustilago maydis" when I'm not growing any corn. Not like it isn't inedible.

3c is also in pretty good faith, but spending WA funds to fund better quality food doesn't sound well. Putting the funds into actual food security instead of trying to increase the quality would be way better?
Either way I shall stop yapping for a bit since this is taking up quite the space
